posts.text: Today I become India's longest-serving elected Prime Minister. This milestone belongs to 1.4 billion Indians whose trust and aspirations have fuelled every reform. Looking forward to my visit to France and Slovakia next week — strengthening partnerships that matter for India's future. #12YearsOfSeva

posts.text: Reflecting on 12 years of India's foreign policy transformation. From neighbourhood first to Act East, from QUAD to I2U2 — we have expanded India's diplomatic footprint like never before. Had an engaging conversation with @SreeramChaulia on the journey and the road ahead.

posts.text: Received a dividend cheque of ₹8,813 crore from SBI today. India's public sector banks are delivering record profitability — a testament to the governance reforms and recapitalisation strategy of the past decade. Also met West Bengal CM to discuss the state's development priorities.

posts.text: The Adani Group continues to invest in India's infrastructure — ports, airports, energy, and data centres. Proud that our efforts have contributed to India's growth story. With a $120 billion valuation, we remain committed to nation-building at scale.

posts.text: I have always believed that a business should create value for the community it serves. The essence of the Tata Group has been trust, purpose, and nation-building. India's journey is one of resilience, and I remain optimistic about what our young entrepreneurs will build next.

posts.text: I have just been informed by our Great Military that last night the Iranians shot down one of our highly sophisticated Apache Helicopters while patrolling over the Strait of Hormuz. There were two pilots involved, both are safe and uninjured. Nevertheless, the United States must, of necessity, respond to this attack. Thank you for your attention to this matter!

posts.text: Facts over click bait. The FBI under my leadership is focused on one thing — protecting the American people. We're restoring accountability, rooting out threats foreign and domestic, and ignoring the noise. Results speak louder than headlines.

posts.text: It is hard to express how big a privilege it has been to serve the American people as White House AI policy adviser. I will be stepping down at the end of June. Grateful for the opportunity to shape AI policy at this critical moment. Excited for what comes next.

posts.text: Where foreign states are found to be engaging in activity that threatens lives or undermines our democratic institutions, we must ensure that such actions have consequences. We will not tolerate hostile actors paying petty criminals to do their dirty work on British soil.
